4485.title: Thread-open argument changes meaning with split option
4485.rootCauseOneLine: Presence of split enables explicit thread targeting; otherwise a lone argument becomes a file on the current context thread.
4485.proposedFix: Separate explicit thread/file intent from pane placement and clarify help.
4485.caveats: Same-agent two-clean actual command/SDK tests with stubbed server boundary; no desktop pane or live file opening.
